_about: Things to gather after hours (see Forage and ForageSpot). Every restaurant day (from 5 AM) each spot either has something or not (spawn_chance), picked from the items that grow where the spot is (where: oak, pine, meadow, pond) in this season (from the real date and the hemisphere; [] = any), weighted by rarity_weights. The same spot shows the same thing all day, and once someone picks it, it's gone until 5 AM. An item with hours (hour blocks from data/time.json) only shows then. Finds go to the Forage Log, and into the kitchen's pantry if pantry is true (kind: what dishes ask for in 'uses', the id if unset); they're never sold. The first of each item unlocks dishes with unlocked_by 'first_<id>' (first_acorn: Acorn Cookies). shape and color/accent are for its little model: acorn, nut, mushroom, cone, sprig, flower, bulb, berry, clover, leaf, shell, spiral, disc, glass, seaweed. Shells and seaweed grow at the beach (where: beach), reached in Cheddar's car.

settings._spots: Where things can turn up, as [x, z]: in the world for the back garden (behind the restaurant: the pond is at -7, -11, the oaks are off to the east), or from the beach's origin for area beach (see data/trips.json; the sea is toward -z, the waterline at z -9.5).

items.name: Acorn
items.description: A shiny acorn with its little cap on. Ground up, it makes nutty cookies.

items.name: Chestnut
items.description: Glossy and round, fresh out of its prickly shell.

items.name: Golden Chanterelle
items.description: A frilly golden mushroom that smells faintly of apricots. Hard to find!

items.name: Button Mushroom
items.description: Small, pale and pops up after rain.

items.name: Winter Enoki
items.description: A cluster of honey-colored caps that only grows in the cold.

items.name: Morel
items.description: A wrinkly little cap like a sponge. Chefs go mad for these.

items.name: Wild Cherry
items.description: Small and tart, dropped from the trees at the edge of the oaks.

items.name: Pinecone
items.description: Not for eating, but lovely on a windowsill.

items.name: Holly Sprig
items.description: Spiky leaves and bright red berries. Pretty, not tasty.

items.name: Pine Needles
items.description: Fresh green tips. They make a piney tea.

items.name: Snowdrop
items.description: A tiny white flower that comes up through the frost.

items.name: Dandelion
items.description: Sunny and everywhere. The leaves go in salads.

items.name: Wild Strawberry
items.description: Tiny and so much sweeter than the big ones.

items.name: Blackberry
items.description: Juicy, inky and worth the scratches.

items.name: Four-Leaf Clover
items.description: One in thousands. Keep it somewhere safe.

items.name: Wild Garlic
items.description: Grows in damp shade and smells wonderful.

items.name: Watercress
items.description: Peppery little leaves from the pond's edge.

items.name: Moonflower
items.description: It only opens after dark, glowing a little in the moonlight.

items.name: Scallop Shell
items.description: A ridged fan of a shell, still warm from the sun.

items.name: Spiral Shell
items.description: Hold it to your ear. Is that the sea, or Cheddar humming?

items.name: Pearly Conch
items.description: Pink and shining inside, like the dawn. A real treasure.

items.name: Sand Dollar
items.description: A flat round shell with a flower on it. Not real money, sadly.

items.name: Sea Glass
items.description: An old bottle, rolled smooth and frosty by the waves.

items.name: Kelp
items.description: Long ribbons of seaweed. Makes a wonderful broth.

items.name: Sea Lettuce
items.description: Bright green and crinkly. Tastes like the seaside.
